desc: Repair the dirty SD64 exFAT fixture and its known ext4 loop image before any further SD-root write. The pinned script accepts only clean/error-found assessment codes, permits only automatic fsck repairs, then repeats read-only checks for ext4 and for exFAT after its final unmount. No repartition, reformat, file deletion, arbitrary raw write, or new hardware-write surface.
author: sol
bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel console=ttydc0 rdinit=/init
pass: Both post-repair read-only checks return clean; the loop detaches and SD64 unmounts cleanly.
stop: Any identity/hash mismatch, fsck result requiring non-automatic repair, mount or unmount failure, PCIe/DART/kernel fault, or lost console.
review_blocker: Independent exact review must verify the repair/check modes, assessment exit-code gates, pinned package and artifact members, identity gates, automatic-only policy, final post-unmount exFAT check, and stop conditions before queue ready.
